evals.description: Bootstrap — initialize pipeline when STATE.md does not exist
evals.prompt: O usuário invoca /sdd-workflow para a feature docs/payment/checkout. Não existe nenhum STATE.md nesse caminho. O que o orquestrador deve fazer e qual saída deve produzir?
assertions: The output indicates that STATE.md will be created with phase: prd for the feature docs/payment/checkout
The output instructs the user to open a new session and execute /sdd-prd
The output does NOT advance to the plan, implement, verify, or done phases in this invocation
The entire user-facing output is written in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)

evals.description: Phase routing prd→plan — advance when PRD.md is detected on disk
evals.prompt: STATE.md existe para a feature docs/user/login com phase: prd e artifacts.prd vazio. O arquivo docs/user/login/PRD.md foi encontrado no disco. Execute o orquestrador SDD para esta feature.
assertions: The output explicitly mentions advancing to the PLAN phase (Avançando para fase: PLAN or equivalent)
The output instructs the user to run /sdd-plan docs/user/login/PRD.md in a new session
The output references the detected PRD.md path (docs/user/login/PRD.md)
The output does NOT generate or propose the content of a PLAN.md file

evals.description: Wave confirmation gate — must wait for user approval before spawning implement subagents
evals.prompt: STATE.md tem phase: implement, current_wave: 1. pending_tasks: [TASK-DOM-TOKEN, TASK-APP-LOGIN-COMMAND]. completed_tasks: []. TASK-DOM-TOKEN tem depends_on: [] e parallel_group: domain. TASK-APP-LOGIN-COMMAND tem depends_on: [] e parallel_group: application. O orquestrador identificou as tasks executáveis desta wave. Como deve proceder?
assertions: The output presents the executable tasks grouped by parallel_group before spawning any subagent
The output explicitly requests user confirmation (e.g., asks for 'sim') before spawning any implementation subagent
The output does NOT spawn or claim to have already spawned any subagent without the user's explicit 'sim' confirmation
The output uses a wave header format (e.g., --- Wave 1 --- or Grupo 1) to display the task plan

evals.description: Done phase — show completion summary with artifact paths in pt-BR
evals.prompt: STATE.md tem phase: done. artifacts: prd: docs/user/login/PRD.md, plan: docs/user/login/PLAN.md. Todas as tasks foram implementadas e verificadas. Invoque o /sdd-workflow.
assertions: The output shows a pipeline completion message for the feature docs/user/login
The output lists both artifact paths: docs/user/login/PRD.md and docs/user/login/PLAN.md
The entire user-facing output is written in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
The output does NOT attempt to advance to any new phase, spawn any subagent, or start any new work
